question: Which offices may read and change the workers compensation claim of a member (injury, medical and prognosis detail, benefits paid, appeal dates, the union representative) and the premium assessment the organization receives from the board, does the representative who holds the member case decide who sees a claim, may a steward read the organization premium and payroll figures, and which board filings must the software itself submit?
decision: WSIB/WCB injury, treatment, benefits and appeal details are visible to the assigned representative/authorized case team and a designated claim or legal oversight officer only through purpose-bound grants; referrals to WorkAid require documented member consent and a limited external mandate. Officer/admin title alone is insufficient. Premium, payroll and assessment figures require financial or occupational-health mandate, not generic steward access. Union Eyes does not submit board filings at launch; appeal milestones and evidence tracking remain functional.
originalProposedDecision: Claim detail: the representative holding the member's case and officers; the representative may grant access to named colleagues. Premium and payroll figures: officers and admins, not stewards. The software submits no board filings.
independentApprovalScope: decision wording / platform baseline only; NOT independent security or operational testing
approvedByRole: Founder & Product Owner, Nzila OS (Nzila Ventures) — platform/product only; contracting legal name unverified
